concerns.text: Task T008c adds an integration test that expects the resource monitor to log a warning when limits are exceeded, but Task T008b explicitly states that warnings have been removed from the resource monitor. This contradiction makes T008c unexecutable as written.

Task T045a extends the per‑run test to assert that a warning is logged when resource limits are exceeded, yet Task T008b removed warning emission from the resource monitor. The test cannot pass without re‑introducing warnings, so the task is currently infeasible.
